title: Generate a course with AI
summary: Describe what you want to learn and let the AI write the course.
focus: The Generate the course dialog and what happens next
content:
## Start

Press **Create a course**. The **Generate the course** dialog opens. It works only when the owner has added a key. Without one the dialog is grey and says so.

## Fill it in

1. **What do you want to learn?** Write a sentence or two. It takes 20 to 2,000 characters.
2. **Your material.** This is optional. Paste notes, homework or a syllabus, or drop in text files. The course teaches exactly that.
3. **What kind of course.** Maths or science, a language, facts and concepts, or let the AI decide.
4. **How much to write.** *Full course* writes as many lessons as the subject needs, at most 15. *Preview* writes one unit with one full lesson. *Outline* lists every unit and lesson with one example question.

Your words go to your AI provider with the key. Do not paste private details.

## While it runs

A progress window shows the phase. It has **Cancel**. The AI writes an outline, then one lesson at a time. Each lesson is checked.

If a run stops, it keeps what was written. Press **Resume** to write only the missing lessons. To start over, delete the course and make a new one.

vocabulary.meaning: the dialog where the AI writes a whole course
a plan of every unit and lesson, without full lessons
writes only the lessons a stopped run is missing

quiz.prompt: What is the fewest characters you can write in the box about what you want to learn?
hints: It is a small number above ten.

quiz.prompt: A full course has at most how many lessons?
quiz.explanation: The AI decides how many, up to 15.
hints: It is more than ten and fewer than twenty.

options: One unit with one full lesson
quiz.correct_answer: One unit with one full lesson
quiz.explanation: A preview is a small first look at the course.
hints: It is the smallest of the three.

quiz.prompt: A generation stops half way. What can you press to finish it?
quiz.explanation: Resume writes only the lessons that are missing.
hints: It continues instead of starting over.

quiz.prompt: Adding your own material to the dialog is optional.
quiz.explanation: You can describe the subject in a sentence or two and leave the material empty.

sorts.title: Which size?

items.text: Plans every unit and lesson as a list
Has one example question per lesson and no word list
The AI decides how many lessons

sorts.why: Full writes everything, Preview a sample, Outline a plan.
